design_or_revision_stage: original K80 analysis; retained in revision
freeze_or_execution_date: original freeze documented before revision review
scope_and_deviation: A=record-axis K80-coded resident death; B=A with UCD K80. The original definition was retained; A-union-official-UCD-K80 is sensitivity only.
interpretation_boundary: Recorded statistical fields only; not clinical truth or an error count.

scope_and_deviation: Added fixed 2018-2024 K80 age-sex weights and fixed support rule. This was not claimed as original preregistration.
interpretation_boundary: Conditional on record-axis K80 and frozen empirical weights.

scope_and_deviation: Added to assess whether model-based homogeneous time effects were appropriate; does not replace empirical direct standardization.
interpretation_boundary: Exploratory diagnostic; no causal subgroup claim.

scope_and_deviation: Four complete alternative partitions: subtype severity entity position and certificate complexity. Priority ontology was frozen before revised estimation.
interpretation_boundary: Separate accounting identities; not causal mediation and not additive across partitions.

scope_and_deviation: Nine mutually exclusive categories were fixed before the corrected 26-year rescan. The zero-padded 113-cause parser was corrected and all years rescanned.
interpretation_boundary: Recorded UCD allocation; not biological substitution.

scope_and_deviation: I21 C18 E10-E14 N18 and A40-A41 boundaries were selected before their benchmark files were analyzed. Added after the original K80 analysis.
interpretation_boundary: Within-condition direction only; no cross-disease magnitude ranking or external validation.

confirmatory_status: Added after methodological review requested joint uncertainty. Endpoint-year multinomial resampling re-estimated both components jointly; seed 20260823 and 100000 replicates.
primary_output_or_source: Quantifies conditional resampling stability of descriptive components; not causality.

confirmatory_status: Added after review identified compositional multiplicity. Joint stratified multinomial bootstrap used 100000 replicates and max-t 95% family-wise intervals; seed 20260823.
primary_output_or_source: All nine categories are one family; nominal intervals are reference only.

scope_and_deviation: CDC WONDER MCD/UCD aggregate checks and age-adjusted population rates were used to distinguish population and disease-conditional denominators.
interpretation_boundary: Not a substitute for direct conditional UCF standardization.

was_relevant_K80_result_seen_before_comp: Bridged and Race Recode 40 regimes were kept separate; official Race Recode 40 at 489–490 was mapped into six groups and 2021 group-specific A/B totals close to the annual main table. COVID and MedCoder are context windows only.
scope_and_deviation: No imputation, causal interruption, or continuous cross-regime race trend.
